youtube.title: Why Spray Paint Cans Rattle 🎨 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Aerosol spray paint cans contain a small ball, often steel or glass, sealed inside. Paint pigment is heavier than the liquid carrier and settles while the can sits unused. Shaking makes the ball churn the contents and re-mix the pigment, because you can't open and stir a pressurized can.
